# HS Strategic CFO Advisory

HS Strategic CFO Advisory provides fractional CFO and strategic finance advisory for Vancouver and BC owner-led businesses. Core work includes cash-flow forecasting, management reporting, financing readiness, acquisitions, and exit planning, with specialist capability in development and real estate finance.

Core topics:
- Fractional CFO and strategic CFO advisory
- Cash-flow forecasting and management reporting
- Lender-ready financial models and financing readiness
- Financing strategy and capital structure
- Business acquisition and exit advisory
- Normalized EBITDA and financial due diligence
- Development finance consulting
- Project financial models and pro formas
- Construction draws and progress claim management
- Real estate investment analysis

Primary service:
- Fractional CFO Vancouver
- URL: https://hsstrategiccfo.com/business-growth-cfo

Audience:
- Owner-led businesses
- Founders preparing for financing
- Buyers and sellers of small and mid-sized businesses
- Developers, project owners, development managers, and construction project teams
- Vancouver and BC real estate investors
